findings.reason: The original standalone tiles show purely textual rank-two root and chamber data. Separate dual-plane finite chamber pictures and infinite affine/root-string pictures materially clarify cyclic order, the different vector spaces, and the inverse in the separation convention. The complete proof remains independent, which does not remove this explanatory need.
findings.action: Added four fenced TikZ illustrations with exact coordinate/convention explanations in final Remarks.

correction: Appended only final Remarks: finite A2 and I2(5) walls/sectors; infinite affine chamber slice and distinct coefficient-plane root strings. Explicitly distinguished N(w) from separating N(w^-1), coordinate angle from Coxeter metric, word length from norm, Coxeter rank two from degenerate form rank one.

diagram_math_checks.objects: V* evaluation coordinates (y_s,y_t); H_(a e_s+b e_t) has equation a y_s+b y_t=0. No B-identification V -> V* is assumed.
checks: A2 roots (1,0),(0,1),(1,1) from Verification 2.1 yield exactly the three drawn full lines.

I2(5) roots (1,0),(0,1),(phi,1),(1,phi),(phi,phi) from Verification 3.2 yield exactly the five drawn full lines; scaling phi(e_s+e_t) leaves y_s+y_t=0. Coordinates in the source are five-decimal approximations to these lines.
Both have Coxeter rank two; finite word lengths are min(k,2m-k) by F5, unrelated to the evaluation-coordinate sector angles.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Sector label k denotes u_k C^circ, with u_k the alternating word starting with s.
checks: A2 labels 0,...,5 occur counterclockwise in sectors with boundaries 0,90,135,180,270,315,360 degrees in these coordinates, matching Verification 2.2 and its six sign patterns.

I2(5) boundaries are 0,90,121.717474,135,148.282526,180,270,301.717474,315,328.282526,360 degrees; hence the y_s-negative labels are 1 through 5 and y_t-negative labels 5 through 9 as in Verification 1.2.

Independent numerical matrix calculation used rho(s)=[[-1,2c],[0,1]], rho(t)=[[1,0],[2c,-1]] from F1 and right multiplication along u_k. Every plotted label (x,y) satisfies (x,y) rho(u_k)e_s>0 and (x,y) rho(u_k)e_t>0: six A2 checks with minimum margin 0.784500; ten I2(5) checks with minimum margin 0.450973.
Standalone original-resolution native views show three/five complete lines and six/ten correctly placed sector labels. No graph closing-edge assumption is involved.

diagram_math_checks.objects: rho left action on V, contragredient dual action on V*.
checks: For f=w.g, g in C^circ, f(alpha)=g(rho(w)^-1 alpha); since roots have definite coefficient sign by F2, f(alpha)<0 iff alpha in N(w^-1). This follows directly from the local dual-action definition and inversion-set definition.

For sector 2=stC^circ, separating roots are es and es+et in A2, es and phi es+et in I2(5), matching N(ts) from Verification 3.1 and the s/t-exchanged recursion F3. The existing N(st) lists have not been relabeled or changed.
H_es meets L at x=0; H_et meets L at x=1. Root es+k u evaluates as x+k, and et+k u as 1-x+k, yielding integer wall traces -k and k+1; thus displayed integer points are genuine root-wall traces.
Verification 6.1 gives s:x->-x, t:x->2-x, st:x->x-2. The displayed intervals (-2,-1),(-1,0),(0,1),(1,2),(2,3) are respectively stC^circ,sC^circ,C^circ,tC^circ,tsC^circ intersected with L.
Chambers themselves are cones over these intervals; the figure is explicitly only their affine traces and continues in both directions.
Verification 2.4 gives es+k u=(k+1,k) and et+k u=(k,k+1). Six plotted points match k=0,1,2 exactly; dashed continuation arrows have direction (1,1).

At c=1, B=[[1,-1],[-1,1]] has rank one, radical generated by u; B((a,b),(a,b))=(a-b)^2, so each plotted root has B-norm one although its Euclidean plotted length increases. Verification 1.3 supplies radical invariance.
The thick u arrow is explicitly a radical vector, not a root. Coxeter rank remains two; inversion cardinalities 2k and 2k+1 equal word length by Verification 2.5.
